notes.title: Free Extra Content Available
notes.content:
We have added extra content. It will be downloaded automatically as if it was a game update.

It is located in game folder.
For example: [Steam Folder]\SteamApps\Common\Obscure2\Deluxe Content, where [Steam Folder] is the directory of Steam on your hard drive.

You will find there:

- The Original Soundtrack (always a pleasure to listen to that masterpiece).
- Exclusive artworks.
- Other stuff to discover.

We are really glad to give you that free content, and we hope you will enjoy it.
